## Chapters
- [Creating StickyNotes on Record Pages](chapter_4344189507.md): The StickyNotes SuiteApp lets you add notes to record pages and keep track of your notes and others' replies.
  - [Installing StickyNotes](section_4084991689.md): Prerequisite Before you install the StickyNotes SuiteApp, go to Setup Company Enable Features.
  - [Configuring StickyNotes](section_4084992363.md): Read the following topics for information about how you can configure StickyNotes: - Setting Account-Level StickyNotes Preferences(https://docs.
  - [Using StickyNotes](section_4084993071.md): The StickyNotes toolbar shows up at the top of a record page when it's enabled.
